metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-165. - Speed.
content.summary:
The speed used for determining minimum sight distance requirements shall be the existing
               posted speed limit of the street. In the event the street is not yet constructed,
               or is to be reconstructed, the anticipated speed limit shall be used.
